paragraphs: Angela Smalios is a dedicated Speech Therapy Assistant practicing independently through the TLC Centre (ABN: 59 644 943 555), with over seven years of experience in the allied health sector.. She is passionate about supporting children and adolescents to develop their communication skills, confidence, and independence within a nurturing and engaging therapeutic environment.

Angela holds a degree in Speech, Hearing and Language Sciences from Macquarie University and is currently in the final stages of her studies to become a qualified Speech Pathologist. Her academic knowledge, combined with her hands-on clinical experience, allows her to deliver high-quality, evidence-informed support to clients and their families.

Angela has a natural affinity for working with young people and brings warmth, patience, and enthusiasm to every session. Being an aunt to eight nieces and nephews has further enriched her ability to connect with children and understand the importance of fostering strong, supportive relationships in their developmental journey.
